name: showroom-first-impression
description: R7-I (audit findings V5/V6/V8/V12): what a shared-tour visitor actually meets. A REAL document load into #/showroom/<code> must NOT raise the 'Where are you?' geolocation modal (V5) while the Scene menu still offers the quiet 'Sun position' way in; the showroom card's CTA must be the accent action (V8); walk mode must not talk about editing (V6); and an IN-SESSION hash change into a showroom must gate the session (V12). Needs the real first-run path, so the scenario sets keepFirstRun and skips only the onboarding carousel.

steps.name: control-prompt-fires-for-a-normal-first-run
steps.failMessage: CONTROL ARM BROKEN: an ordinary first run with no location must still raise the location primer. If this fails, the V5 assertions below prove nothing.

steps.name: showroom-booted
steps.failMessage: A real document load into #/showroom/<code> did not enter view-only mode.

steps.name: V5-no-location-modal
steps.failMessage: V5 REGRESSED: the geolocation primer is covering a showroom visitor's first paint.

steps.name: V8-cta-is-accent
steps.failMessage: V8 REGRESSED: 'Make it mine' is no longer the accent action on the showroom card.

steps.name: V6-walk-copy-is-view-only

waitFor.text: Leave walk mode to go back to the overview

steps.failMessage: V6 REGRESSED: the walk hint still offers editing inside a showroom.

steps.name: open-scene-surface
steps.eval: (async () => { const narrow = window.innerWidth <= 960; if (narrow) { document.querySelector("button[aria-label='Menu']")?.click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); document.querySelector("button[aria-label='Scene']")?.click(); } else { [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => (b.textContent||'').trim().startsWith('Scene'))?.click(); } })()

steps.name: scene-surface-open
steps.failMessage: Scene surface did not open (desktop menu / mobile rail).

steps.name: V5-sun-position-row-exists
steps.eval: (()=>{ const hit=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b=>/^Sun position/.test((b.textContent||'').trim())); if(!hit) throw new Error('no Sun position row mounted'); })()

steps.name: V5-prompt-opens-on-demand
steps.failMessage: V5 OVER-CORRECTED: a showroom visitor can no longer ask to change the location.

steps.name: V12-in-session-hash-hop
steps.eval: (()=>{ const h = document.location.hash; document.location.hash = ''; document.location.hash = h; })()

steps.name: V12-route-is-live
steps.failMessage: V12 REGRESSED: an in-session hash change to #/showroom/<code> left the session editable — the route is being read at boot only again.
